'''2003 World Championship Day 2 Jonny Chu DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2003 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu (2003-09-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30220 Speed Deal w/ Ket Maliss]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060514235247/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30220 Internet Archive]</ref>
